pages.text: Any head takes a $(l)Turret Pedestal$(). The thirteen that fight still fight. Any other is a $(l)Lookout$(): a hostile within 16, in sight, and it raises its species' alarm every 5 s and makes the hostile glow. 1 FE/t, 2 alarmed.

A $(l)comparator$() on the pedestal reads 15 while it is alarmed, or while a fighting head has a target, and 2 s after.$(br2)Wire it to a redstone lamp: the cow lights the hall.$(br2)$(o)Cow heads do not bite. That is not the point.$()
